id_rule: Read only the pinned Unit index. If absent use practice_001; otherwise use one greater than the highest exact practice_### ID. Do not search the repository for IDs.
asset_rule: Saved HTML is self-contained. Any required graph/image is embedded directly in HTML and carried into the PDFs; do not create extra asset files or broken relative links.
navigation: Teacher Practice Builder exposes Build New Practice and Saved Practices. Saved Practices is grouped by Unit and links directly to Student PDF/HTML, Teacher Key PDF/HTML, and Source Map.
security: Saved teacher practices are public practice resources. Do not use this library for secure summative material or private Portfolio data.
preservation: Never overwrite a prior saved practice. Preserve every existing Unit-index record and append exactly one new record.

qa.pdf_rule: Render PDFs only from final finalized HTML bytes and visually inspect first/middle/final pages as applicable.

dependency_authority: pms_build/practice_builder.txt contains the complete required/optional dependency path manifest. Executors must not search the repository to infer additional build conventions.
